name: Critical Pump Power Loss
description: A fault on the cable that feeds Pumping Station PS-2 (line B32–B33) removes supply from PS-2's bus. After isolation the electrical outage is small, but PS-2 is the only pump of the West pressure zone: the hospital's water service now depends on what is left in Tank T2.
narrative: 17:00 — fault on the PS-2 supply cable (line B32–B33); recloser SW-06-26 trips the Feeder F3 lateral.
17:02 — SW-32-33 isolates the faulted cable and the lateral is reclosed: every bus except B33 is back.
The remaining electrical outage is about 80 kW — but it is the West zone's only pump.
B33 sits inside the isolated section, so no switching plan can re-energise PS-2 before repair.
The extended-period hydraulic simulation shows how long Tank T2 can carry the West zone and when hospital pressure falls below the 20 m service threshold.
